snippet.title: Figure It Out! Together - Trailer | Cozy Anime Co-op Tidy-Up Game
snippet.description:
Your cat knocked over your anime figure collection. Time to tidy up, together! 🐱

WISHLIST ON STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5319600/Figure_It_Out_Together/

Figure It Out! Together is a cozy anime organizing game. Sort over 2,875 mini, life-size and giant figures back onto their shelves, alone or with up to 3 friends in online co-op. Mechas, chibis, maids… everyone belongs on a shelf.

KEY FEATURES
● 2,875+ Figures: Spot familiar silhouettes in colorful piles and reunite every figure with its set, from tiny chibis to giant display pieces.
● Co-op for up to 4 Players: Divide the piles, track down missing figures together and build a display worthy of your favorite fandoms.
● Your Cat Can Help: Pet and feed your cat, and it scrambles the piles to reveal buried figures. Ignore it, and your perfectly sorted shelves get a plot twist.
● Cat Robot Helper: Your yellow cat robot gathers scattered figures and delivers them to you in a handy pile.
● Handy Gadgets: Unlock magnets, scanners and more through the skill tree.
● Collect More Cats: Unlock new breeds and colorful companions, even a shimmering holographic cat!
● Lucky Gacha Pulls: Try the maneki-neko gacha machine for legendary holographic figures and helpful surprises.

Coming soon to Steam. Wishlist now to get notified at launch!

📧 Press & creators: hello@ugc90.com
